preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of points in each test case is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r_i <= 10**9 for r_i in rs)
preconditions.description: Layer number of each point is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= r_i for c_i in cs)
preconditions.description: Point number in each layer is between 1 and the layer number.

preconditions.expression: all(len(rs) == len(cs) == n for n, rs, cs in zip(ns, rss, css))
preconditions.description: Each test case has the same number of layer and point numbers.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 0 for cost in output)
postconditions.description: Each output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum cost.
